title: Vitest worker timeout fixed by rollback
l0: Vitest worker timeout during billing tests.
l1: When bun test packages/billing times out with the worker timeout signature, rollback the fake timer patch before retrying.

title: Vitest worker timeout fixed by cache clear
l0: Vitest worker timeout during billing tests.
l1: When bun test packages/billing times out with the worker timeout signature, clear .vitest-cache before retrying.

title: Billing test setup uses deterministic clock
l0: Billing tests set a deterministic clock.
l1: Set BILLING_CLOCK=fixed before running recurring invoice tests.

title: Billing retry queue drain
l0: Drain retry queue after invoice tests.
l1: Run bun run billing:drain-retries after invoice retry specs to leave Redis clean.

title: Billing webhook fixture owner
l0: Webhook fixtures belong in billing tests.
l1: Keep Stripe webhook fixtures under packages/billing/test/fixtures/webhooks rather than shared fixtures.

title: Billing worker smoke path
l0: Worker smoke path checks settled invoices.
l1: The billing worker smoke path must assert settled invoice ids before webhook replay.
